name: time-picker
title: Time picker
description: Pick a time of day with hour, minute and AM/PM segments, using the browser's own control.
a11y: Native input type="time": the browser exposes hour, minute and AM/PM as spinbuttons.
ArrowUp/ArrowDown change a segment, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight or Tab move between segments, typing digits fills one.
The control takes its name from a label or aria-label; min, max and step are passed through.
